title: docs/test.md "Known Coverage Gaps" still points to the retired Beads tracker (bd ready / bd list)
outcome: The "Known Coverage Gaps" section of docs/test.md says: "The active follow-up list lives in Beads. Use `bd ready` for currently unblocked work and `bd list --status=open` for the wider open inventory." Beads was retired on 2026-09-28, and TermAl's tracker is Engram (project github.com/grlap/TermAl, bound by .engram-project). Agents run no bd command. The section should point to Engram instead: its `next` and `ls --ready` reads, without tracker ids in the text.
acceptance: docs/test.md no longer tells readers to use Beads or any bd command, and names Engram as the tracker for follow-up work, without tracker ids.
The full five-stage gate passes on the reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
